sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4-RTX5090 is a quantized checkpoint of Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B language model optimized for NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPUs using NVIDIA's Model Optimizer tool. Built by gittensor-model-hub, this checkpoint compresses the original 53 GB BF16 model to 18.8 GB in VRAM while maintaining the full native 262,144-token context window on a 32 GB RTX 5090. sources.snippet: A 9.57B Qwen3.5-derived agent model tuned on 3,346 Fable reasoning traces, with Hermes tool calling and an MTP head. The hybrid decoder interleaves 24 Gated-DeltaNet linear-attention layers with eight full-attention layers.
